## Problem

What is wrong or missing today, and why it matters.

## Approach

What this change does and why this way. Mention alternatives you rejected.

## Look at this sceptically

Where a reviewer should spend their attention: the risky part, the
assumption, the thing you are least sure about.

## Checklist

- [ ] `scripts/task check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the behaviour change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` if user-visible
- [ ] Title is a Conventional Commit (it becomes the squash commit on `main`)
